# googleads_ad_group_audience_criterion (Resource)

Audience or demographic criterion attached to an ad group. Exactly one variant must be set (user_list_id, age_range_type, or gender_type). Status and bid_modifier are mutable; everything else is immutable. Use `googleads_ad_group_criterion` for keyword criteria.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Bid 1.5x more for the 25-34 age range.
resource "googleads_ad_group_audience_criterion" "boost_25_34" {
  customer_id    = "1234567890"
  ad_group_id    = googleads_ad_group.main.id
  age_range_type = "AGE_RANGE_25_34"
  bid_modifier   = 1.5
}

# Target a remarketing list (created in the Ads UI for now).
resource "googleads_ad_group_audience_criterion" "previous_visitors" {
  customer_id  = "1234567890"
  ad_group_id  = googleads_ad_group.main.id
  user_list_id = "customers/1234567890/userLists/12345678"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ad_group_id` (String) Parent ad group resource name. Immutable.
- `customer_id` (String) Google Ads customer ID.

### Optional

- `age_range_type` (String) AGE_RANGE_18_24 / 25_34 / 35_44 / 45_54 / 55_64 / 65_UP / UNDETERMINED. Immutable.
- `bid_modifier` (Number) Bid multiplier in range 0.1–10.0. Mutable.
- `gender_type` (String) MALE, FEMALE, or UNDETERMINED. Immutable.
- `negative` (Boolean) If true, exclude the audience rather than target it. Immutable.
- `status` (String) ENABLED, PAUSED, or REMOVED. Mutable.
- `user_list_id` (String) Target/exclude a user list (remarketing list, customer match, similar audience, etc.). Resource name of a user_list (customers/{cid}/userLists/{id}). Immutable.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource name (customers/{cid}/adGroupCriteria/{ag_id}~{criterion_id}).
